title: Aston Martin’s Valhalla Spider Is Coming for Ferrari’s PHEV Supercar
extract: Aston Martin is reportedly preparing an open-top Valhalla Spider, potentially arriving as early as November, giving the plug-in-hybrid supercar a rival to Ferrari’s open-air performance cars.

title: I Loved the 2026 Aston Martin DB12 S, But I’d Buy This Cheaper Aston
extract: A review of the hotter DB12 S highlights its 690-hp twin-turbo V8, carbon-ceramic brakes, titanium exhaust option and sharper chassis tuning, while comparing it with a cheaper Aston alternative.

title: 2024 Gordon Murray Automotive T.50 for Sale With Only 62 Miles
extract: A nearly unused Gordon Murray Automotive T.50 with just 62 miles is heading to auction, offering a rare chance to acquire one of the fan-assisted, naturally aspirated V12 hypercars in essentially delivery-fresh condition.

title: Some of the most iconic cars in the world look worse when US spec is applied
extract: A look at how American safety regulations have forced visual changes to some of the world’s most recognisable Ferraris, Lamborghinis and Porsches, often producing distinctly different-looking cars from their European counterparts.

title: Malicious npm packages evade install-script defenses at runtime
extract: A new npm malware campaign shows how malicious packages can bypass installation-script protections by hiding their payload in normal runtime behaviour, with the impersonating package already attracting millions of weekly downloads.

title: Researchers escape OpenAI Codex sandbox to run commands on host
extract: Security researchers disclosed two Codex sandbox escapes, including one that could turn an untrusted repository into host command execution; OpenAI patched both flaws shortly after they were reported.

title: Ten days that changed the course of AI
extract: Reuters examines a turbulent ten-day period in AI development, including safety warnings, researchers leaving frontier labs and growing concern about increasingly autonomous systems.

title: Aston Martin’s Valhalla Spider Is Coming for Ferrari’s PHEV Supercar
extract: Aston Martin is reportedly preparing an open-top Valhalla Spider, potentially arriving as early as November, giving the plug-in-hybrid supercar a rival to Ferrari’s open-air performance cars.

title: DJSOFT Releases Dracula for Amiga and ZX Spectrum
extract: DJSOFT has released a new gothic text adventure for Amiga and ZX Spectrum, combining illustrated locations, a traditional parser and real-time pressure with puzzles inspired by Bram Stoker’s Dracula.

title: Space Trolls of Mahlsdorf Targets ZX Spectrum Hardware
extract: A new ZX Spectrum shoot ’em up built with MPAGD and Shmupkit supports both ULA+ and the standard ULA palette and has been tested on original 128K hardware, Spectrum Next and emulators.

title: Amix: Amiga Unix gets 68040/68060 support
extract: A new Amiga Unix kernel and patch extend Amix beyond its original 68020/68030 support, allowing the classic System V port to run on 68040 and 68060 processors.

title: Puzzle game: Connect 1.5
extract: Connect 1.5 brings a technical optimisation to the Amiga puzzle game, allowing background music to work on machines with only 512 KB of RAM while also speeding board generation.

title: Livecoding tool: Copper Showdown Editor 0.5.0
extract: Copper Showdown Editor 0.5.0 updates its dependencies, refreshes the editor UI, adds a new sound example and introduces an audio wake-up timer for its real-time Amiga Copper-list workflow.

title: Real-time strategy: StarCraft port AmiSC 0.7.1
extract: AmiSC 0.7.1 advances a native AmigaOS 3.x port of StarCraft with a computer opponent and improved 320×240 and 640×480 modes without requiring PC emulation.

title: Bloc Party Score Highest UK Album Chart Peak in 14 Years
extract: Anatomy of a Brief Romance has entered the UK Albums Chart at number six, giving Bloc Party their strongest chart position since Four reached number three in 2012.

title: Watch AC/DC’s Angus Young sign fan’s baby
extract: Angus Young appeared at an AC/DC PWR/UP pop-up in Toronto after the band’s concert was cancelled, with footage showing him signing a young fan’s baby.

title: AC/DC’s Dirty Deeds Done Dirt Cheap Turns 50
extract: AC/DC’s Dirty Deeds Done Dirt Cheap reaches its 50th anniversary in September, marking five decades since the Bon Scott-era album helped establish the band’s harder, more confrontational sound.

title: David Bowie’s 'Fame' Hits No. 1 Today
extract: A look back at David Bowie’s first US Billboard Hot 100 number one, Fame, which reached the top of the chart on September 20, 1975.

title: Star Trek is turning 60 – and the vision it promised feels more distant than ever
extract: On Star Trek’s 60th anniversary, Dave Schilling reflects on the franchise’s optimistic future and how its vision contrasts with the growing militarisation of space.
